description:
In 1912, Elizabeth Krebs founder of the Hiawatha Garden Club in Kansas, decided to put an end to the destruction of her flower beds by throwing a town-wide party to tire out the local kids. Watch how her determination created the modern Halloween traditions of costumes, music, and trick-or-treating. Season 5, Episode 13: Halloween.
